description: "Ludicrous Aspects Of Christianity" by Austin Holyoake is a critical examination of the Christian faith, particularly its representation of Jesus Christ, and likely written in the late 19th century. This work is a response to a challenge posed by the Bishop of Manchester, discussing themes around religious belief, interpretation, and what Holyoake perceives as contradictions and absurdities within the Gospels.
